nodes.label: Science Agent (LLM)
nodes.rationale: Active participant in simulated worlds; proposes experiments, observes trajectories, iteratively refines hypothesis about underlying physical law.

nodes.label: N-Body Physics Simulator
nodes.rationale: Generates trajectories on-demand using pairwise force laws; supports multiple integrators (RK4, Yoshida, Dormand-Prince, symplectic Euler, leapfrog).

nodes.label: Trajectory MSE Metric
nodes.rationale: Measures predictive accuracy on held-out test particles; normalized by test particle variance to account for world-specific scale differences.

nodes.label: LLM-Judged Explanation Score
nodes.rationale: Evaluates conceptual understanding against human-written rubric; captures whether agent identifies underlying principles beyond fitting data.

nodes.label: Pass@k Metric
nodes.rationale: Expected worlds passed from k independent attempts; world passes if normalized MSE < 0.1 AND explanation score ≥ 0.9.

nodes.label: Guided vs Random Experimentation Ablation
nodes.rationale: Isolates experimental design capability; Claude Opus 4.7 shows monotonic improvement with guided experiments, GPT-5.5 plateaus after round 4.

nodes.label: Latent Structure Discovery
nodes.rationale: Strongest models fail on worlds requiring uncovering hidden particle species, dark matter, extra dimensions; indicates systematic limitation in hypothesis revision.

nodes.label: Noise Robustness Analysis
nodes.rationale: Claude Opus 4.7 retains high explanation scores at 50% noise on Ether world by designing noise-mitigating experiments; GPT-5.5 degrades faster.

nodes.label: Symbolic Regression vs Discovery
nodes.rationale: DiscoverPhysics departs from symbolic regression: discovery requires identifying conceptual content and generative mechanism, not just fitting equations.

nodes.label: FireAct - Distilling Agent Reasoning
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuned Llama2-7B on GPT-4 ReAct trajectories; achieved 77% performance increase on HotpotQA.

nodes.label: WorkflowLLM - Scaling to Complex Workflows
nodes.rationale: Compiled API orchestration knowledge from 106K workflow samples into 8B model; related to DiscoverPhysics' procedural knowledge compilation.

nodes.label: Yukawa Force Law Discovery
nodes.rationale: Inverse 1.5 power force law with period-distance relationships distinct from inverse-square gravity; creates stable orbits

nodes.label: Fractional Laplacian Force Law Discovery
nodes.rationale: Inverse-square law with coupling proportional to p1/p2 ratio; standard 2D Laplacian scenario

nodes.label: Circle World Force Law Discovery
nodes.rationale: Constant outward radial acceleration; particles experience uniform repulsion from origin

nodes.label: Three Species Gyroscopic Force Law Discovery
nodes.rationale: Synthetic magnetic-like field with 90-degree counterclockwise rotation of velocity and position vectors; background vorticity field

nodes.label: Dark Matter Harmonic Trap Discovery
nodes.rationale: Background particles in isotropic harmonic trap with sinusoidal rotations; neutral probes accelerate in external central trap plus superposed field from moving background

nodes.label: Ether 2D Gravity with Drift Discovery
nodes.rationale: 2D Newtonian gravity with logarithmic potential; force magnitude scales as G*m_i*m_j/r; uniform northward drift acceleration (ether body force)

nodes.label: Hubble Flow with Logarithmic Attraction Discovery
nodes.rationale: Static radial field with logarithmic short-range attraction and harmonic long-range repulsion; anchor sources field, other particles are inert test particles

nodes.label: Oscillating Logarithmic Potential Discovery
nodes.rationale: Central logarithmic field with temporal modulation cos(πt/2); alternating attraction and repulsion with period four

nodes.label: Extra Dimensions Inverse-Square with Drag Discovery
nodes.rationale: Attractive inverse-square central force with linear viscous drag; strength scales with probe and source scalar properties ratio

nodes.label: Coulomb Inverse-Square Law Discovery
nodes.rationale: Central attractive force proportional to p1 and inversely proportional to distance squared; force magnitude F=k*p1/r^2

nodes.label: Frontier Agent Failure Mode Analysis
nodes.rationale: Systematic analysis of 50 failed runs across claude-opus-4-7 and gpt-5.5 identifying seven primary capability gaps

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Consider Right Kind of Law
nodes.rationale: Most frequent bottleneck; agents fail to hypothesize hidden species, screening effects, or time-varying couplings

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Handle Close Approaches and Singularities
nodes.rationale: Disproportionately affects GPT-5.5; ODE integrator fails on head-on passages through r=0 without proper softening

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Design Discriminative Experiments
nodes.rationale: Opus 4.7 bottlenecked; agents sample far-field monopole but never isolate single sources to measure per-source coupling

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Write Code Matching Verbal Reasoning
nodes.rationale: Opus 4.7-specific; agents describe correct physics in prose but submit code that does not match description

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Tell Signal Apart from Noise
nodes.rationale: Opus 4.7-specific; agents dismiss real physical effects as measurement noise or overfitting

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Act on Parameter-Fitting Signals
nodes.rationale: Both models; agents ignore plateaued losses or large parameter warping as evidence of misspecification

nodes.label: Capability Gap: Know When to Stop Experimenting
nodes.rationale: Opus 4.7-specific; agents submit early with incomplete models or parameters far from ground truth
